# TransformerEmpoweredActorCritic

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reinforcement learning architecture that integrates transformer-based sequence modeling into the actor-critic framework to handle temporal dependencies and long-range credit assignment. This enhances the capability of neuromorphic agents to learn complex sequential decision-making tasks in dynamic network environments.
